mapper.select: select * from user_share where userId = #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and type = #{type,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT us.`id`,tf.fileName,tf.sourceUrl,tf.absolutelyUrl,tf.pictureHeight,tf.pictureWidth,tf.coverUrl FROM user_template_info us LEFT JOIN template_info tf ON us.`templateId` = tf.`id` WHERE us.`userId` = #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND tf.fileName LIKE '%${search}%' and tf.typeName!="视频" ORDER BY us.`createData` DESC
